  a22 : Int

spec_meta.positive_lean:
namespace PubDC13

structure M2 where
  a11 : Int
  a12 : Int
  a21 : Int
  a22 : Int

def tr2 (M : M2) : Int := M.a11 + M.a22
def addM2 (A B : M2) : M2 := ⟨A.a11 + B.a11, A.a12 + B.a12, A.a21 + B.a21, A.a22 + B.a22⟩

theorem trace2_additive (A B : M2) : tr2 (addM2 A B) = tr2 A + tr2 B := by
  simp only [tr2, addM2]
  omega

end PubDC13
